administered_pps.method: sfrxUSD.pricePerShare() = pricePerShareStored x e^(rate x (t - lastSync))
administered_pps.admin_basis: timelockAddress() is a 3-of-6 Safe (not a timelock) that may set stored PPS and rate

frxusd_usd_mark.upstream_feed_ref: frxusd_backing.json peg (same Chainlink feed; frxUSD's own dashboard)

usd_share_reference.face_value_basis: PPS x $1 per frxUSD (the issuer's and the research's convention)

accrual.basis: CONFIGURED accrual if held constant; not realized strategy earnings and not a cap

total_assets_formula.basis: totalSupply x PPS by formula; NOT an inventory query

frxusd_held_by_token.basis: frxUSD.balanceOf(sfrxUSD token): what the Ethereum contract actually holds

convert_to_assets_1_share.basis: ERC-4626 view = totalAssets / supply; NOT a redeemable local rate (deposit/redeem are disabled on Ethereum)

market_mark.scope: CoinGecko aggregate across its tracked sfrxUSD venues (all chains it lists), not one pool

deviation_face_value.basis: against PPS at $1 per frxUSD; includes frxUSD's own deviation

treasury_pool_quote.basis: DIAGNOSTIC: Curve get_dy(100 shares) in a pool whose LP the controller owns ~all of; the operator controls this depth

primary_exit.status_basis: legs_simulate_settlement_untested = every route link checks out AND both legs execute as eth_call at their own blocks; cross-chain delivery, compose and payout were not tested
primary_exit.payout_token: frxUSD (on Ethereum, via the frxUSD OFT); NOT a dollar cash exit
primary_exit.eligibility: permissionless at both legs: Hop.mintRedeem has no allowlist; the redeemer requires only shares and approval (owner == msg.sender). Proven for the test holder by simulation

ethereum_adapter_to_fraxtal.basis: quoteOFT(sendParam) OFTLimit; uint64 max is LayerZero's no-limit default

fraxtal_frxusd_lockbox_to_ethereum.basis: quoteOFT(sendParam) OFTLimit; uint64 max is LayerZero's no-limit default

destination_inventory.basis: mdwrComboView()._maxSharesRedeemable = previewWithdraw(frxUSD cash): fee included, priced at the STORED vault price (redeem() first refreshes it from the oracle)
destination_inventory.inventory_vs_capacity: contract inventory any holder (Fraxtal or remote) can draw; NOT confirmed cross-chain capacity and NOT an independent valuation

fee.hop_fee_basis: 10000-based markup on the RETURN messaging fee (ETH), not on the redeemed amount

pricing.underlying_price_basis: priceFeedUnderlying is the zero address, so the contract returns a constant 1e18
pricing.freshness_basis: latestRoundData().updatedAt is the CURRENT block time (computed round, not a fresh valuation); lastSync is the last time the stored PPS parameters were written

ethereum_vs_fraxtal_parameters.basis: agreement is common administration (same controller), not independent corroboration

ethereum_source_leg.method: eth_call Hop.mintRedeem(adapter, 1000 shares) from the test holder with msg.value = quote, plain and with a verified state-override sfrxUSD balance + approval to the Hop and 1 ETH
ethereum_source_leg.proves: the Ethereum source leg (pull, adapter burn, LayerZero send with compose) executes at this block; NOT delivery, compose or payout

fraxtal_redeem_leg.method: eth_call redeem(shares, test holder, test holder) from the test holder with a verified state-override Fraxtal sfrxUSD balance + approval to the redeemer
fraxtal_redeem_leg.preview_vs_execution_note: redeem() refreshes the stored vault price from the oracle first, so execution can differ slightly from previewRedeem
fraxtal_redeem_leg.proves: the Fraxtal redeem leg pays frxUSD from the redeemer's own cash at this block for any holder with shares and approval; NOT that an Ethereum holder's message reaches it

cross_chain_settlement.basis: no transaction, approval or bridge transfer is sent; delivery latency, compose execution and recovery are unmeasured
